    Who are the favorites to win the WBC 2026?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    The United States and the Dominican Republic are the overwhelming favorites to win the 2026 World Baseball Classic, with oddsmakers consistently placing them at the top, often followed by Japan, Venezuela, and sometimes Puerto Rico or Mexico as strong contenders. While the USA often starts as the favorite due to roster depth, the D.R.'s powerful lineup and pitching have made them a very close second, with some experts even favoring them as the tournament progresses.
     
    Top Contenders:
    • United States:
      Generally the early favorite, boasting immense talent, though they've shown vulnerability at times. 
    • Dominican Republic:
      A powerhouse with elite MLB stars, often seen as the biggest threat to the USA. 
    • Japan:
      A perennial contender, even with some roster changes, still a major force. 
    • Venezuela:
      Another strong Latin American team with significant MLB talent, always a threat. 
    • Puerto Rico & Mexico:
      Often considered dark horses or strong third/fourth contenders, with Mexico reaching the semifinals recently. 
    Expert Sentiment:
    • Many experts believe the tournament will ultimately come down to the USA and D.R., with the Dominican Republic's overall strength making them a compelling choice for many. 
    • Italy: has also emerged as a popular "Cinderella" or value pick due to strong performances and fun play. 
    In essence, while the USA might have the edge in betting odds, the Dominican Republic is widely seen as its equal, if not superior, in terms of on-field potential.
